
## 🎮 CosmoU for Wii U

**`CosmoU-WiiU-0.13.0.wuhb`** is CosmoU as an app on the Wii U itself. It shows the games installed on your Wii U (system memory, USB drive and disc) in CosmoU's look, with Covers and Grid views, four themes with their music, and starts them, on the TV and the GamePad.

**Install:** you need a Wii U with the [Aroma](https://aroma.foryour.cafe/) homebrew environment.
1. Copy `CosmoU-WiiU-0.13.0.wuhb` to your SD card into `wiiu/apps/`.
2. Put the SD card back into the Wii U and start **CosmoU** from the Wii U Menu.

**Controls:** D-pad or stick to move · **A** start · **Y** Covers / Grid · **X** theme · **−** music on/off · the touch screen works too.

This Wii U version is a one-time release for 0.13.0 and won't get updates.
